_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); premium revenue, medical care ratio, fee revenue, operating cost ratio and operating margin signals with UnitedHealth Group's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'UnitedHealth Group is a diversified health and well-being company, whose focus is on improving the overall health and well-being of the people we serve and their communities and enhancing the performance of the health system.' 'If we fail to effectively estimate, price for and manage our medical costs, the profitability of our risk-based products could decline and could materially adversely affect our future financial results.' 'Premium revenues from risk-based products comprise approximately 90% of our total consolidated revenues.'; no disruption theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a health benefits company on this date (OFFSHORE is scoped to IT services), so the watch list is empty and these words stay here (the PEP obesity rule)

classification.quality_note: 'UnitedHealth Group is a diversified health and well-being company, whose focus is on improving the overall health and well-being of the people we serve and their communities and enhancing the performance of the health system.' 'If we fail to effectively estimate, price for and manage our medical costs, the profitability of our risk-based products could decline and could materially adversely affect our future financial results.' 'Premium revenues from risk-based products comprise approximately 90% of our total consolidated revenues.'; no disruption theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a health benefits company on this date (OFFSHORE is scoped to IT services), so the watch list is empty and these words stay here (the PEP obesity rule). durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.33x; -14% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.66; conservative 2yr +51%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -15.7%/yr (worst year FY01-FY11, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +7.4%/yr (FY12 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +21.1%/yr (FY01-FY11 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +38.8%/yr (best 2-yr run FY01-FY11, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: UNH (retrospective, 2012-01-20) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.33x (50.1% downside to Bear $26.07 / +150.1% upside to Bull $130.75) | Adj composite 2.31 vs market 1.65: gap +0.66 [UNDERVALUED] | -14% above the EPP floor $60.45 (13x FY12E $4.65) | Conservative 2-yr case: +50.7% total (+25.4%/yr) | At 11.2x FY12E the 15% hurdle price $69.13 sits at or below the BASE case; revenue +7.8% YoY in Q4 2011, forward revenues +5-6% (FY12 revenue guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
